text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow… We're fin'lly here in Sapporo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y'know, the air kinda reminds me of home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Queen Stakes is held at Sapporo Racecourse. And it seems that the area's similarity with Morioka is helping Yukino Bijin to relax.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Wait a second… Isn't that girl over there popular in Tokyo?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Wait, is she the Snow Angel?! She's a real cutie! She must be here for the race today.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Should we go watch it? I wanna see how she races!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: U-um! I'd love t'see you there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin seems wound up before the race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This's my chance to steal everyone's hearts!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And then, maybe things'll be diff'rent at the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: Yukino. Put your hands up in the air!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh. My head feels crystal clear now!
choice_data_list: I know you can do it, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: Now go out there and show everyone what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You got it! See you later, alligator!
